# SlowedLab

> SlowedLab is a free, private browser audio studio for changing playback
> speed, adding reverb, shaping tone with EQ, compression and distortion, and
> exporting a finished WAV. Audio is processed on the visitor's own device —
> files are never uploaded to a server.

## What it does

- Variable-speed playback (0.50×–1.50×), including slowed + reverb presets
- Reverb plus EQ, compression and distortion, tuned live while audio plays
- Waveform visualization with click-to-seek
- Presets, including custom ones (Slowed + Reverb, Nightcore, Bass Boosted, Lo-Fi Chill, Ethereal Dream, Crystal Clear, Distorted)
- Paste a SoundCloud link to play it directly in the studio, or upload a local file
- Export to WAV
- Works with MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, AAC and more, up to 200 MB

## How to use it

1. Paste a public SoundCloud link (Cloud link tab) or upload audio files (Your files tab, or drop them anywhere).
2. Pick a preset or tune speed, reverb, EQ, compression and distortion yourself.
3. Preview with the waveform, seek by clicking, then export the mix as WAV.

Note: a minority of SoundCloud streams are DRM-protected for third-party
clients and cannot be imported — uploading the audio file always works.

## Key facts

- URL: https://slowedlab.app/
- Pricing: free, no account required
- License: MIT
- Author: Gwhyyy (https://github.com/anasfik, https://x.com/gwhyyy)
- Privacy: audio processing happens in the browser, not on a server
- Requirements: a modern browser with Web Audio API support and JavaScript enabled
